releaseNotes: Fixed agent detection on macOS and Linux when Rift is launched from Finder, the Dock or the rift command: the app now resolves the login shell PATH so Claude Code and OpenCode installed via npm, nvm, Homebrew or the native installers are found.
Common CLI install locations such as /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/.local/bin are always searched even if the shell probe fails.
